title: High-Density DSH-Style Context Compaction system with collapsible paper-styled accordion and model configuration
author: agent-developer (tauri-rust-engineer & react-tailwind-artisan)
summary: Implemented High-Density DSH-Style Context Compaction system. Rust backend condenses dialogue history prior to the last 2 active turns using an authoritative 7-section structured system prompt, with model inheritance ('inherit' default or custom override) and resilient HTTP client with deterministic fallback. Persists compacted markdown into SQLite table dialog_items with type = 'compacted' and archives older intermediate entries. React 19 frontend renders a tactile collapsible paper-styled accordion strip in White Paper / Vercel design, an on-demand 'Сжать контекст' button in DrawerSteerBar, and a Compactor Model selector in SettingsModal.
